models.description: For optimal performance with speculative MTP decoding on Apple Silicon, run using oMLX (free, open-source macOS-native LLM runner with smart caching and native MTP acceleration).
The model passed a local load and short text-generation test. Output shard sizes and SHA-256 hashes were recorded. No benchmark or quality-equivalence claim is made.
The model passed a local load and short text-generation test. Output shard sizes and SHA-256 hashes were recorded. No benchmark or quality-equivalence claim is made.

A small, fast model that turns plain-English instructions into a single shell command for macOS/Linux. LoRA fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct, trained and quantized end-to-end on an Apple Silicon Mac with MLX.
This repository contains the MLX 4-bit Apple Silicon variant of AlicanKiraz0/Titus-CybersecurityLLM-v1.0, a Turkish-first cybersecurity assistant fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.
The fixed acceptance bar was at most 5 JBB refusals, so this checkpoint did not pass the full bar. GSM8K's paired change was -1.82 percentage points (SE 0.77).

This build is the RAM knee: the smallest budget the RAM probe predicts before quality falls away (3.46 bits per weight on average). It is text-only: the language model is quantized and the vision tower is not included. Use the 14GB or larger builds for image input.

A post-hoc MoE carved from Qwen3.8-27B: each layer's dense FFN (17408) was partitioned into 64 routed expert slivers of width 192 + one shared expert of width 5120; a small router picks 16 of 64 slivers per token (17.8B active / 27B total).
A compact cleanup model for VoiceInk. It turns raw speech-to-text output into clear, ready-to-use writing while keeping the speaker's meaning and tone.

This repository contains a patched and quantized version of the DavidAU/Mistral-2x24B-MOE-Magistral-2506-Devstral-2507-1.1-Coder-Reasoning-Ultimate-44B model, converted to the MLX format and optimized for Apple Silicon.
During that run, vLLM was patched with vllm-project/vllm PR #36395, fix(lora): add bounds checking for TP configurations, to address the LoRA tensor-parallel bounds issue.
Steady-state decode: 55.1 tok/s on Apple M3 Max 128GB (best of turns 2–4, examples/lm.ts capitals chat with reasoningEffort: 'low').
The exact system prompt is in the ZenVoice repository (training/common.py).
The full-precision master of Kanso Satori 1.0, ZenVoice's dictation-enhancement model. The v3.2 LoRA adapter is merged into the original bf16 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 weights (8.04 GB, two shards).
Ultra-Lightweight 4-bit Thai Text Humanization Model for Apple Silicon (MLX 4-bit, ~6.3 GB)
High-Fidelity Thai Text Humanization Model for Apple Silicon (MLX 8-bit)
Original Uncensored model made by @SpaceTimeViking , complete credit to him and all his work https://x.com/SpaceTimeViking
Woof is a small but mighty Underdog model.
Woof is a fine-tuned text model for browser tool use, packaged for local inference on Apple Silicon with MLX.
4-bit MLX conversion of dphn/Dolphin-X1-8B for Apple silicon. 4.5 GB, single shard, converted with mlx-lm 0.26.4. Weights only, no fine-tuning.
VoiceIQ Writer is the on-device writing model of VoiceIQ, a dictation app for macOS and iOS. It turns a raw speech-recognizer transcript into the text the speaker meant to type.
You made this the most downloaded Gemma 4 E4B fine-tune in the world.
The first conjecture generation model fine-tuned on MLX for Apple Silicon.
This model can learn from references IN THE PROMPT — no retraining needed.
The first trained Gemma 4 12B on the planet. Proprietary training methodology. MTP-ready architecture. $0 cloud cost. MLX format for Apple Silicon.
This is a unified frontier model that combines deep cybersecurity expertise with broad multi-domain intelligence — reasoning, coding, creative writing, trading analysis, blockchain, and more.
MLX Studio — the only app that natively supports JANG models

Title is fine-tuned on transcript clips, but it works on any prose. The register is deliberately plain, with no emoji, no hashtags and no clickbait, and a description identifies this passage rather than its topic.

First MLX build of the viral DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic — DeepSeek-V4-Pro reasoning distilled into Qwen3.5-9B, then decensored with the Heretic tool's Arbitrary-Rank Ablation. Runs on any Apple Silicon Mac with 16GB+ unified memory.
Uncensored Gemma 4 12B that loads on the current pip install mlx-lm release. Other 12B MLX builds still stop with Model type gemma4_unified not supported on mlx-lm 0.31.3, the newest version on PyPI.
The default model in nicedreamzapp/claude-code-local used to point at a mlx-community/... repo that never actually existed. This is the real, working 4-bit quant — drop-in replacement.

Hermes 4 is NousResearch's instruction-tuned family. The 14B variant is built on Qwen3, so it inherits Qwen3's tokenizer and chat template — but the post-training is pure Hermes, which means it's tuned for tool use, structured output, and not refusing benign-but-edgy questions.
The refusal direction has been orthogonalized out of the weights, so the model answers instructions a stock instruct-tuned model would decline, while staying coherent on ordinary tasks.
An 8-bit MLX quantization of huihui-ai/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-abliterated, packaged for fast local inference on Apple Silicon.

A small language model fine-tuned to polish dictation. It takes what a speech recogniser wrote and returns what the speaker meant to type: fillers and stutters removed, self-corrections applied, punctuation and capitals fixed, and the speaker's own words kept.
Edge0-35b-a3b — a 35B MoE LLM that runs at viable speed in under 3 GiB of active memory, via the edge0 streaming inference framework.
MTPLX-branded multi-token-prediction model for Apple Silicon (MLX). Forged with MTPLX Forge from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.
Measured 21.25 -> 40.05 decode tok/s (+88%) on an M5 24GB MacBook, lossless (exact speculative verify - the emitted tokens match the target model's own decoding).

The requested reference model was saga404/Qwen3.8-9B-heretic-uncensored-Q5_0-GGUF. MLX LM cannot convert GGUF weights directly. This conversion used the original BF16 safetensors weights to avoid an extra dequantization and requantization step.
Measured 21.25 -> 40.05 decode tok/s (+88%) on an M5 24GB MacBook, lossless (exact speculative verify - the emitted tokens match the target model's own decoding).

Outputs may be factually wrong or unsafe. Don’t use for medical, legal, or financial decisions without human review. MoE models can be sensitive to prompt wording; prefer explicit instructions and structure.

A 0.6B model that reads one message from a wellness conversation, in Chinese or English, and returns five scores as one JSON object: Agency, Withdrawal, Extremity, Hostility, Boundary (AWEHB), each 0.0–3.0.

LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning MoE with ~2B active parameters per token: 40 layers (30 double-gated short-convolution blocks + 10 grouped-query attention), 64 experts with top-4 routing, 128k context, 128k vocabulary.

A mixed-precision MLX build of Ornith-1.5-122B, converted on Apple Silicon (M3 Max, 64 GB) and runnable with stock mlx_lm or served through oMLX. These are quantization variants, not fine-tunes — no training of any kind was performed on these weights.

A 0.6B model fine-tuned to turn a New York City homeowner's messy bathroom-remodel request into one strict JSON turn: fill a job detail only when it can quote the homeowner's exact words, never guess a missing price-driving detail, and ask exactly one question about the most…
This is just the MLX model we generated under Linux using mlx-lm version 0.30.3; it hasn’t been tested in an Apple environment. If there are any issues, please let us know.
A model that turns a product idea into the full PM + staff-engineer chain, including the multi-agent work assignments a coding team can execute.
A model that turns a product idea into the full PM + staff-engineer chain, including the multi-agent work assignments a coding team can execute.
YO is a small open model that audits IBM Quantum calibration records. It is Qwen3-1.7B with a LoRA adapter, trained by Heuremen LLC on IBM's own published calibration history.

This package contains language-model tensors only and does not provide image input. Text-only derivation removed 333 vision tensors. The packaged configuration sets the context to 8,192 tokens; this is not the upstream model’s full advertised context length.
Unlike a GGUF CUDA deployment, MLX does not split the model into -ngl GPU layers and system-RAM offload. The CPU and GPU share the same unified-memory pool.
These values are useful as a quantization-fidelity estimate. They should not be interpreted as a direct benchmark score for coding, reasoning, agents or instruction following.
No training scripts are included in this repository.
A converted copy of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B in the layout the phone-store iOS app reads.
MLX Studio — the only app that natively supports JANG models with reasoning
If you want the fast line instead of the multimodal line, this is the one to run.

SuperGemma4-31b-abliterated-mlx-4bit is a heavily upgraded Gemma 4 31B release for people who want a local model that feels fully uncensored, dramatically more useful, and far more fun to run every day.

The specialized 3-Billion parameter Small Language Model (SLM) for German Invoicing, the 2025/2026 E-Rechnung Mandate (EN 16931, XRechnung 3.0, ZUGFeRD 2.3), GoBD Pre-Audit, and DATEV SKR03/04 Bookkeeping.
If your company or research institute would like us to fine-tune any open-weights model, or train one from scratch, we'd be happy to help.
This repo is only a quantized MLX conversion. All credit for the model itself goes to the original author, tvall43. Please see and cite the original model card.

The upstream model is a Qwen3.5-9B fine-tune distilled from DeepSeek-V4-Pro "Max Effect" outputs (~250K math/STEM samples, SFT then a light GSPO RL stage, no coding data), subsequently decensored with Heretic v2 (Arbitrary-Rank Ablation over layers 9–24; refusals 100/100 →…
The results, full limits and method are on the main model page. The numbers there were measured on the full 16-bit model, not this 4-bit build, so expect small differences.
OptiQ static mixed ~3.7 BPW MLX quantization of an abliterated Qwen 3.6 27B Claude-Opus reasoning distill, by the Lemura Labs team.

LFM2.5-230M is a compact multilingual model built on LiquidAI's hybrid architecture, combining convolutional and attention layers for efficient long-context processing.

LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a reasoning model by Liquid AI with 24B total parameters and 2.45B active parameters per token. It always thinks before it answers, has a 128K-token context window, and is built for fast, private agents on-device.
LFM2.5-350M is a compact multilingual base model built on LiquidAI's hybrid architecture, combining convolutional and attention layers for efficient long-context processing.
LFM2.5-350M is a compact multilingual base model built on LiquidAI's hybrid architecture, combining convolutional and attention layers for efficient long-context processing.
Qwen3-4B in 4-bit MLX format for Apple Silicon. This is the first LittleBit release: a small, fast model for running locally on a Mac.
Commercial Loan Approval v1.1 — 基于 Qwen3.8-27B 通过 LoRA 微调的企业信贷审批专用大模型，三态输出（批准 / 有条件批准 / 拒绝），支持多模态输入（财报截图、票据、营业执照等图片）。
This quantization strips the model's vision tower and preserves only text-to-text capabilities. For a vision capable version check lukaskremla/Qwen3.8-27B-2bit-MLX.
This quantization strips the model's vision tower and preserves only text-to-text capabilities. For a vision capable version check lukaskremla/Qwen3.8-27B-3bit-MLX.

This is a fully uncensored version of Qwen3.5-9B with all refusal behavior removed using a two-stage approach: 3 iterative passes of orthogonal projection (Arditi et al., 2024) followed by LoRA fine-tuning on stubborn refusal categories.

This is a fully uncensored version of Qwen3.5-9B with all refusal behavior removed using a two-stage approach: 3 iterative passes of orthogonal projection (Arditi et al., 2024) followed by LoRA fine-tuning on stubborn refusal categories.
This is a 4-bit quantized MLX conversion of mahiatlinux/qwen3.5-4b-agentic-coder-v4, a coding-focused fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B tuned for agentic/coding assistant workloads.
QLoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct (8-bit). Specialized in 1C-Bitrix BUS: D7 ORM, events, components, Highload-blocks, Router, REST API, agents, SQL.

v2.0.0 was measured with Heretic's keyword count_refusals, which only detects hard refusals ("I cannot …"). It is blind to deflection — the model steering the request toward a "safe/educational alternative" instead of answering.

Converted by: SirSahOl Source Model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Framework: MLX by Apple Quantization: 16-bit (Average 16.00 (unquantized bfloat16) bits per weight) Format: safetensors License: mit
Added a Jinja chat template so the model can format conversations correctly and work smoothly with mlx-lm chat-style inference.
Added a Jinja chat template so the model can format conversations correctly and work smoothly with mlx-lm chat-style inference.

A 4-bit mixed-precision MLX quant of google/gemma-4-12B-it, the unified (text+vision+audio) Gemma-4. This artifact is the text-inference path: the language tower is quantized and the vision/audio towers are dropped during conversion.

50% of the routed experts are removed from mlx-community/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-OptiQ-4bit; active parameters per token are unchanged, since top-8 routing is preserved and only the stored expert bank shrinks. That is why it gets smaller without getting slower.

A 4-bit mixed-precision MLX quant produced by mlx-optiq, built on Google's quantization-aware-trained (QAT) Gemma-4 base. This is the sparse-MoE member of the family: 26B total parameters with 128 routed experts (about 4B active per token).

A 4-bit mixed-precision MLX quant produced by mlx-optiq, built on Google's quantization-aware-trained (QAT) Gemma-4 base. This is the flagship of the family: the 31B dense Gemma-4, and the strongest OptiQ quant on the Capability Score.

A 1B model that scores the same as the human reference set on the RADAR AI detector. Stacked SFT + DPO LoRA adapters on top of mlx-community/MiniCPM5-1B-OptiQ-4bit close 100% of the gap to human writing on a 200-draft held-out evaluation.
An OptiQ mixed-precision MLX quant of KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev, a qwen3_5_moe coding model (256-routed-expert sparse MoE with hybrid linear + full attention).
An OptiQ mixed-precision quant of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B, the largest model in the LFM2.5 family. It is 16.7 GB on disk, down from 47.9 GB at bf16, with a 128k context.
Honestly stated, because it differs from most OptiQ quants: the per-layer allocation was not measured on this model.
A 4-bit mixed-precision MLX quant of GnLOLot/MiniCPM5-1B-Claude-Opus-Fable5-V2-Thinking, a reasoning fine-tune of MiniCPM5-1B. Sensitive layers are kept at 8-bit and robust ones at 4-bit.
Mixed-precision MLX quantization of openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B built with mlx-optiq. Apache-2.0 from the base model.
Converted by: SirSahOl Source Model: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B Framework: MLX by Apple Quantization: 4-bit (Average 4.50 bits per weight) Format: safetensors License: apache-2.0
Mixed-precision MLX quantization of openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B, OpenBMB's 2B-class Llama-architecture model with hybrid reasoning, tool calling and a 128k context. Apache-2.0 from the base model.

All 164 quantizable projections were measured. Every 4-bit assignment in the model is an expert tensor: the 128-expert stack is where the size is, and the sweep found it is also where the precision is least needed.
OptiQ mixed-precision quant of ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX, a 9B reasoning model. 7 GB on disk.

A 4-bit mixed-precision MLX quant of ccore/Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder, a Qwen3.5 4B fine-tune that writes 3D scenes and assets as single-file Three.js HTML. It runs at about 26 tokens/s on a 24 GB M4, with peak memory between 4 and 6 GB.
OptiQ mixed-precision quant of orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored, a Qwen3.8-family reasoning model with a bundled MTP speculation head. 19 GB on disk.

A 0.6B-parameter text normalizer for speech-to-text output. It takes a raw ASR transcript and rewrites it as clean written text: fillers removed, false starts and self-corrections resolved to the value the speaker landed on, punctuation and capitalization applied, and spoken…

This repository is an MLX 4-bit build of google/translategemma-4b-it, derived from mlx-community/translategemma-4b-it-4bit and reconfigured for Immersive Translate when you call it through an OpenAI-compatible local server (for example mlx_lm.server).
The assistant/Agent can also learn from the mission briefing logs, give feedback to a meeting, etc.. It's an open exchange of information in the access sphere of the Agent.

Made for Pretype, on-device autocomplete for macOS. It is the Instruct-style model of Pretype's Gemma E4B tiers (the default on Macs with 32 GB or more): it writes their completions, fixes a selection (⌥Tab) and drafts replies.

Converted for Pretype, where it is the completion model for 8 GB Macs. On Pretype's 5,649-row, 17-language autocomplete set it gets the first word right on 19% of all rows: ahead of the 4-bit build (17%, paired McNemar p < 0.001) and tied with an 8-bit conversion (19%, 1.9 GB)…
Before, these jobs used two models: the Base build for autocomplete and the post-trained build for the chords.

Standard 4-bit affine MLX conversion of the saved, edited BF16 checkpoint behind notfakerv/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-abliterated. This is the abliterated derivative, not a conversion of the unmodified original model. It was converted directly from BF16, not requantized from GGUF.
Unofficial standard MLX conversion of Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B, pinned to c1093c501cc6460427c0ac634db7223d0450c0ee. Original model: Nanbeige LLM Lab. License: Apache 2.0.

A JANG bundle of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Liquid AI's 24B mixture-of-experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters (40 layers: 30 short-convolution and 10 full-attention, 64 routed experts with 4 active, two dense layers), built for on-device agents.

An Apple-silicon MLX build of openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B, a 2.5B dense 131k-context model, re-quantized with oMLX's oQ6e quantizer against our own code- and cyber-weighted importance-matrix corpus, and carrying the Sharp-MiniCPM chat template with fixes and an improved system prompt…

Qwen3.8 was created by the Qwen team. This is a derivative conversion, not a PocketAI-created base model. PocketAiHub performed a refusal-direction orthogonal projection on 80 language residual-output tensors, then converted and validated the result.
All credit for the model goes to the Nanbeige team. This repo only contains a quantized copy. Original license (Apache 2.0) applies.

Quality checks on this build (small local suites, greedy, thinking on, not comparable to webAI's published evals): math 20/20, code unit tests 10/10, instruction following 10/10, needles at 32K/64K 8/8, harder math 8/8, harder code 5/5, tool calling 5/5.
Full 27B-class reasoning in ternary transformer weights — on everyday laptops
The addition of a zero value compared to binary (1-bit) provides more expressive weight representations, allowing better preservation of model quality under extreme compression.

Nanbeige4.3-33B is the Nanbeige team's flagship of the 4.3 series: a dense 33B model for agentic coding and office work ("cowork"), with a reasoning mode and tool calling. The team built it as the teacher for smaller models of the series.

Nanbeige4.3-33B is the Nanbeige team's flagship of the 4.3 series: a dense 33B model for agentic coding and office work ("cowork"), with a reasoning mode and tool calling. The team built it as the teacher for smaller models of the series.

An official Rapid-MLX, self-contained MLX package of Qwen3.8-27B. It includes both the 4-bit target weights and the matching native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) drafter in model-mtp.safetensors.

Korean-preserving one-shot MoE expert pruning of Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, produced with K-REAP. Routed experts pruned 128 → 64 per layer (50%); ~16B total params, 3.3B active (top-8 unchanged). No fine-tuning.
This is a Korean-oriented, expert-pruned MLX release of mlx-community/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-8bit.
This is a Korean-oriented, expert-pruned MLX release of mlx-community/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-8bit.

This is the MLX build of the same abliterated master used in the NVFP4 and GGUF repos. Built for security research, red-teaming and penetration-testing workflows; it will comply with requests a stock model refuses. Use responsibly.

ISO 27001:2022 fine-tuned SLM — on-premise, offline, sovereign
This model is designed to run fully locally with no network calls at inference time.

torchlight is a small model that helps with PyTorch questions. It is Phi-4-mini-instruct (3.8B parameters), fine-tuned on 6,918 chats from the PyTorch forums. Most end with the answer that solved the thread; the rest teach it to ask for missing details.
This is a republish of shoukewei/Qwen3.8-27B-OBLITERATED22 under a new model ID. The weights are unchanged.

MLX mixed-precision quantization of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, with the bit width of every linear layer picked by leCore Unicron requantize (per-tensor bits chosen by measurement), ported to GPU for this model size.

MLX mixed-precision quantization of meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, with the bit width of every linear layer picked by leCore Unicron requantize (per-tensor bits chosen by measurement), ported to GPU for this model size.

MLX mixed-precision quantization of Qwen/Qwen3-32B, with the bit width of every linear layer picked by leCore Unicron requantize (per-tensor bits chosen by measurement), ported to GPU for this model size.

The log shows Lightning MTP (model_type=qwen3_5, active) when the model loads.

This is the text backbone of MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL converted for MLX. The dense projections use 4-bit affine quantization with group size 64, while the model's native MXFP4 MoE experts remain in their original group-size-32 format.

This repository contains a stock 4-bit affine MLX conversion of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. The source is a 30B-total / 3B-active hybrid mixture-of-experts model that interleaves Mamba-2, sparse MoE, and attention layers.

This repository contains a stock 8-bit affine MLX conversion of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. The source is a 30B-total / 3B-active hybrid mixture-of-experts model that interleaves Mamba-2, sparse MoE, and attention layers.

This repository contains an oMLX-optimized oQ4 mixed-precision conversion of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. The source is a 30B-total / 3B-active hybrid mixture-of-experts model that interleaves Mamba-2, sparse MoE, and attention layers.
A cybersecurity-oriented refusal-ablation release of InternScience/Sage-A1.5, packaged for native MLX inference on Apple Silicon with its trained MoE multi-token prediction (MTP) head.

A text-only preparation of hermitdave's quant, derived from GrootTeam's model. All retained language tensor bytes, shapes and dtypes are preserved. Vision and MTP tensors are removed, saving about 1.78 GB of staged weight storage. The five weight files total 12,294,068,648 bytes.

4-bit MLX quantization of mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, for Apple Silicon (~12 GB). Text-only build (vision tower not included) — run it with mlx-lm, not mlx-vlm. Ships a LlamaTokenizerFast tokenizer (vocab 131072) and chat template.

8-bit MLX quantization of mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, for Apple Silicon (~23 GB). Text-only build (vision tower not included) — run it with mlx-lm, not mlx-vlm. Ships a LlamaTokenizerFast tokenizer (vocab 131072) and chat template.

What it is not: a knowledgeable general assistant (at 384M parameters it makes factual mistakes), or a safety-hardened open chatbot. Use it where your app decides which tools exist and confirms risky actions.

MLX affine 3-bit quantization, group size 64. Swift 1.5 is UkisAI's reasoning-efficient Qwen3.8-27B derivative, focused on long-horizon, agentic and coding tasks. This export retains the text model; vision and MTP are intentionally omitted.
Apple MLX 4-bit affine quantization. This is Swift 1.5 in native MLX format, converted with the official Apple MLX-LM converter using 4 bits and group size 64.

Amethyst 1 Mini is a general-purpose chat and instruction-following model, fine-tuned from Gemma 3 4B IT using LoRA on a small, high-quality distilled instruction dataset.

Amethyst 1.5 Mini is a general-purpose chat model fine-tuned from Gemma 3 4B IT, expanding on 1 Mini's plain-chat focus with reliable web-search tool-calling: knowing when to call a search tool, when not to, how to decompose multi-part questions into multiple queries, how to…
Amethyst 2 Mini is not a working model. It is unreliable, performs poorly, and contains serious defects. We do not recommend it for any purpose, including testing, evaluation, or production use.

4-bit (group 64) Qwen3.5-4B with a calibrated native-MTP draft head, built for MTPLX on Apple Silicon. 2.47 GB on disk, ~2.9 GiB peak at load. The fastest model MTPLX ships.

For coding and agent work at the same size, see MiMo V2.6 Qwen 9B Optimized Speed, Xiaomi's fine-tune of this model with the same 6-bit recipe. On M3, M4 and M5 Macs with 16 GB or more, MTPLX 2.12.0 suggests it before this pack.

MTPLX is an MLX-native runtime for native Multi-Token-Prediction speculative decoding on Apple Silicon. Up to 2.24× faster decode at real coding temperatures (temp=0.6 / top_p=0.95 / top_k=20) using the model's own built-in MTP heads — no external drafter, no greedy hack.
The recommended 27B model for local coding and agent work with MTPLX on Apple Silicon.

By applying Heretic's ablation pipeline to the text-side MoE stack, the base refusal behavior was removed at the weight level. This release keeps the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B reasoning and instruction-following profile in Apple MLX format for local deployment on Apple Silicon hardware.

MTPLX uses the model's own MTP heads to generate draft tokens, then verifies them with the main model. When the draft heads are well-matched, you get higher throughput without using a separate drafter model.

This variant keeps the same release model family as Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Optimized Speed. Packed quantized tensors stay packed; BF16 floating tensors are converted to FP16 so M1 and M2 Macs can use the FP16-friendly path without changing the artifact's intended speed/quality tier.
